reflection.learning: did a lot of reflection today on why i lied, specifically about the uber thing. what went wrong: i lied and then kept the lie going, casually slipping fabricated details into normal conversation to keep up the narrative. i looked someone i love in the eye and chose comfort over honesty, without thinking about how that deception would mess with his reality. i basically told him my aversion to conflict mattered more than his peace of mind, so it makes sense he says he doesnt recognize me right now and that the trust is gone. the root cause goes back to my childhood i think - growing up, messing up meant getting yelled at and shamed and conflict and whatnot, so i learned to hide things, smooth things over, and manage other peoples emotions. i became a people pleaser because conflict makes me physically sick with anxiety. the hard truth is im still using child me's old survival mechanism in my adult relationships - my brain treated a tiny potential conflict as a massive threat and my reflex was to hide it to feel safe, but trying to protect myself from temporary discomfort ended up destroying the trust of the person i love the most. my fear of people being mad at me is causing the exact rejection im terrified of. the stuff im actually going to try i think is next time im about to lie to avoid something small, i want to catch myself before it comes out, even if that means going quiet for a second instead of immediately answering. i want to get more comfortable just saying i messed up out loud instead of tensing up like its the end of the world, even in small dumb ways with random people so it stops feeling like death every time. when that anxiety thing comes up because someone might be upset with me, i want to try to actually sit in it instead of doing whatever i can to make it go away, because making it go away is exactly what got me here. and if a lie starts coming out of my mouth i want to just stop and say wait, that wasnt true, right there instead of letting it ride. and i want to start now, however small and stupid no more white lies or anything. the stress and anxiety of lying is much worse than having someone be mad at me and this is something i thought i came to terms with but apparently not 100% so i need to understance where the gap is. none of this is about trying harder, its about not being so scared of someone being mad at me that i turn into someone i dont recognize.
reflection.valueLived: responsibilty - let sadiq do his thing instead of relying on him, stayed off of reels all day, kept the 10am cafe commitment even though i didnt want to, and im trying to think through the mom situation logically instead of just reacting on emotions
reflection.freeWrite: today was still heavy but there were a few small pieces of light in it - the walk, the pen, the texts from rey, staying off reels, the desk and chair. it doesnt fix anything with him, but doing the work above on the lying stuff feels like the start of becoming someone different. i miss him so much it physically hurts (and i always thought people were exaggerating when they said that lol). but i want to keep showing up for myself even on the days that are hard.
